description: This file defines the interface for the upper PHY layer in a wireless communication system, including class declarations, method signatures, and documentation for processing downlink and uplink PDUs, event handling, and resource management.

classes.name: upper_phy
classes.description: Interface class representing the upper PHY layer, providing access to its components, event notifiers, and control functions.

methods.name: ~upper_phy
methods.description: Default destructor for the upper_phy interface.

methods.name: get_operation_controller
methods.description: Returns a reference to the operation controller of this upper PHY.

methods.name: get_rx_symbol_handler
methods.description: Returns a reference to the receive symbol handler.

methods.name: get_timing_handler
methods.description: Returns a reference to the timing handler.

methods.name: get_error_handler
methods.description: Returns a reference to the error handler.

methods.name: get_downlink_resource_grid_pool
methods.description: Returns the downlink resource grid pool.

methods.name: get_uplink_pdu_slot_repository
methods.description: Returns the uplink PDU slot repository.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns the metrics collector or nullptr if not enabled.

methods.name: set_timing_notifier
methods.description: Sets the timing notifier for this upper PHY.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the upper PHY, waiting for pending tasks to complete.
